question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Since".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"Since" **is used to indicate a starting point in time or a cause-effect relationship.
 
• It is followed by a clause or a noun
